about: What each MIDI CC sets on the Torso S-4 (OS 2.x), for CC 0-127, in the units its project.json stores. Measured: CCs sent at known values in calibration projects, the project saved on the S-4 and read back. Generated by s4tools (tools/make_ccref.js) from js/s4params.js and js/ccmap.js.

parameters.mode: CHROMATIC ('chromatic'); with TEMPO STRETCH the field is PITCH

parameters.note: the sample's own tempo, whole BPM
g = the grid in beats (1/4 = 1), n = the sample's length in grid steps: 0 to the last step
T = the sample's length in seconds
one grid step to the whole sample
1 to 15 bars: the 30 s a TAPE holds. Measured at 120 BPM only

parameters.mode: RANDOM ('') / RANDOM MONO ('rand mono') / WARP ('warp') / WARP MONO ('warp mono')
BIT CRUSH ('') / REDUX ('redux') / BIT CRUSH/REDUX ('bit crush/redux')
PHASE SHIFT ('') / PING PONG ('ping pong') / DIFFUSION ('diffusion')
MATERIAL ('') / INPUT 1/2 ('in1/in2') / INPUT 1 ('in1') / INPUT 2 ('in2') / TRACK 1 ('track 1') / TRACK 2 ('track 2') / TRACK 3 ('track 3') / TRACK 4 ('track 4') / MIX ('mix')

parameters.note: off: the value stays where it is
not stored in a project, so its scale can't be read from a save
measured on macros without routings; the screen shows a macro as uni- or bipolar depending on its routings
